lines.trans: It feels good to tell the truth.
Absolutely, sincerity is essential.
I am totally on board for the film!
You accept despite all our problems?
I am delighted to sink with you!
Your reaction is incredible, Jean!
My character followed his dream in the past.
He dived to the very end of his passion.
Like in The Big Blue!
This new script resembles that spirit.
You are saving Xavier's project!
We are going to create a magnificent work.
Thank you a thousand times for your trust.
See you soon for filming, Andrea!

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to accept, to agree'.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Elle a refusé mon projet autrefois.

examples.text: Vous avez rejeté mon scénario autrefois.
